For the Petitioner : M/s. Abhijeet Kumar Singh, Advocate For the State : M/s. Nawin Kr Singh,
A.P.P.
-----
02/08.09.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Kadma P.S. Case No. 98 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 409, 419, 420, 120-B, 34 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Jamshedpur.
3. Petitioner happens to be the ex-Branch Manager of Uliyan Branch, Bank of India.
He has sanctioned overdraft worth Rs. 924.29 lakhs in favour of several person against their Term Deposit Receipt (TDR).
4. It was submitted that several accused persons who had withdrawn overdraft from the account have been granted bail by this Court as well as by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

entities.text: Dhiraj Kumar Jha vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Jamshedpur in connection with Kadma P.S. Case No. 98 of 2023.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Nandini/-
